B-V10.text: All real. All mine. Built by me and Onion — so if you got an idea, we can build it. Onion Core. Let's go.

B-V2.text: Come here, I wanna show you something.

B-V3.text: I'm Blaze. I build apps — like, a LOT of apps — with my AI.

B-V4.text: Her name's Onion. She's my Muse — and honestly, she's basically my whole dev team in one.

B-V5.text: Everything on this phone that matters? We built it. Look —

B-V6.text: Onion Browser — my own browser. Fast, private, and it even checks if your accounts ever got leaked.

B-V7.text: Haven — the app. It helps people find food, shelter, real help near them. That one matters to me.

B-V8.text: Onion APK Editor — my secret weapon. Open any app up, look inside it, pull out what I need, rebuild it.

B-V9.text: Care Circle — helps families run childcare. Schedules, check-ins, payments, all in one place.
